title: Encrypt the Mempool #1, March 4, 2026
summary: EIP-8105 (Universal Encrypted Enshrined Mempool) withdrawn; replaced by Lucid design New Lucid EIP published (PR #11376); more engineering-specific than research post Lucid: two-slot design with tickets reserving block space, keys revealed post-inclusion Prevents front-running; may reduce back-running efficiency by requiring full top-of-block backrun Penalty mechanism: 1/64 of top-of-block fee retained if key not rev
